sadvipadacatuppada.p: [ saha + dvipadacatuppada ] (ti) CL=7 A being who has two legs and A being who has four legs.

DOP: dvāra duvāra n.m. , and ~ā, f. [ S. dvāra, n. ], 1. a door; a doorway, an entrance; a passage ; Abh 219 (~aṃ ca paṭihāro); 1110 (paṭihāre mukhe ~aṃ); Vin II 220, 5 foll. (chabbaggiyā bhikkhū jantāghare … aggiṃ datvā ~aṃ thaketvā ~e nisīdanti); III 38, 36 (kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ divāvihāragato ~aṃ vivaritvā nipanno hoti); Pv 19:6 (pidahitvā ~aṃ bhuñjāmi mā maṃ yācanakāddasuṃ, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be bhuñjiṃ); Ja I 150, 12 (migagaṇaṃ uyyānaṃ pavesetvā ~aṃ pidhāya); 346, 30´ foll. (~āni pidahanto sabbadvāresu sūcighaṭikādayo datvā sattamaṃ talaṃ abhiruhitvā tattha pi ~aṃ pidahitvā nisīdi); VI 441, 5* (aggiṃ ~ato dema; 441, 8´ : ~aṃ pidahitvā tattha aggiṃ dema); 524, 25 (so gehe dubbalaṭṭhānaṃ thiraṃ katvā ~aṃ paṭisaṅkharitvā); Ap 90, 28 (sobhayanto mama ~aṃ kapparukkho patiṭṭhati); Vism 41, 12 (bhagavatā ~aṃ dinnaṃ tasmā vaṭṭatī ti, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se duvāram); Sp 299, 28 (yaṃ pana ~e ṭhito mātugāmo bhājanadhovana-udakaṃ chaḍḍeti); 1122, 3 (sītasamaye ~aṃ ca vātapānaṃ ca supidahitaṃ kātabbaṃ); Ps III 220, 23 (tassā guhāya ~e pilakkharukkho ahosi); Sadd 425, 19 foll. (dvaranti saṃvaranti rakkhanti etenā ti ~aṃ, atha vā dve kavāṭā aranti gacchanti pavattanti etthā ti ~an ti … pāḷiyan tu ~ā ~an ti ca itthinapuṃsakavasena °-saddo vutto tathā hi ~aṃ pi surakkhitaṃ hotī ti ca ~ā p’ esā ti ca tassa dviliṅgatā vuttā); — ifc see agga- ( sv agga 1 ), apāruta- ( sv apāpurati ), āṇi-, giri-, culla- ( sv culla 1 ), pure-, mahā- ( sv maha[t] ); — 2. a gate of a town, a gateway ; Vin I 230, 7 (yen’ ajja samaṇo Gotamo ~ena nikkhamissati taṃ Gotamadvāraṃ nāma bhavissati); D II 83, 16 (ye kho keci oḷārikā pāṇā imaṃ nagaraṃ pavisanti vā nikkhamanti vā sabbe te iminā va ~ena pavisanti vā nikkhamanti vā ti); S I 58, 9 (catusu ~esu dānaṃ dīyittha); A II 241, 16 (dakkhiṇena ~ena nikkhāmetvā dakkhiṇato nagarassa sīsaṃ chindissanti); Ja IV 4, 10* (sabbe apihitā ~ā); VI 276, 4* (aṭṭālake ca ~e ca maṇimhi passa nimmitaṃ); Ap 240, 14 (dakkhiṇamhi duvāramhi); 599, 13 (~ena Haṃsavatiyā Gaṅgā sandati sabbadā); Mil 58, 5 (°-ttā); Mhv 5:47 (dakkhiṇena duvārena pavisitvā); — 3. a door as a means of access; a way, a means ; Vin I 7, 4* (apārutā tesam amatassa ~ā; Sp 963, 17 : amatassa ~ā ti ariyamaggo, so hi amatasaṅkhātassa nibbānassa ~aṃ); Ja I 366, 27* (atthassa ~ā pamukhā chaḷ ete; 367, 15´ : vaḍḍhisaṅkhātassa … atthassa ete pamukhā uttamā cha ~ā upāyā adhigamamukhānī ti); VI 229, 9* (n’ atthi ~aṃ sugatiyā); 373, 14* (atthassa ~āni avāpuranto); — esp. the sense-organs and the mind, as means of access for experience ; It 24, 10* (cakkhu sotaṃ ca ghānaṃ ca jivhā kāyo tathā mano etāni yassa ~āni suguttāni ’dha bhikkhuno); Th 125 (makkaṭo pañcadvārāyaṃ kuṭikāyaṃ … ~ena anupariyeti); Dhs 597 (cakkhuṃ p’ etaṃ … loko p’ eso ~ā p’ esā samuddo p’ eso …); Ap 18, 9 (saṃvutā chasu ~esu; Ap-a 221, 6 : cakkhādīsu chasu ~esu rūpādīsu chasu ārammaṇesu saṃvutā); Mil 54, 28 (ayaṃ abbhantare jīvo yena yena ~ena icchati passituṃ tena tena ~ena passatī ti); 418, 16 (yoginā yogāvacarena … cha ~ā pidahitabbā); Vism 37, 10* (rūpesu saddesu atho rasesu gandhesu phassesu ca rakkha indriyaṃ ete hi ~ā vivaṭā arakkhitā hananti); 599, 32 (cakkhādīni cha ~āni); Spk III 62, 23 (kāyo nagaran ti vutto tass’ eva °-bhūtattā cha āyatanāni ~ānī ti); 245, 27 (ekasmiṃ pana ~e javanaṃ rajjati vā dussati vā muyhati vā); Th-a I 242, 20 (manacchaṭṭhānaṃ channaṃ ~ānaṃ … rakkhitattā guttadvāro); III 22, 1 (tena ~ena abhijjhādayo pāpadhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ); Saddh 356 (chasu ~esu); — ifc see kāya-, gutta-, ghāna-, cakkhu-, jivhā-, pañca-, mano- ( sv mana[s] ), sota- ( sv sota 1 ); — and the passage or means (of good or bad action) ; Ja I 276, 28 (kāyadvāraṃ vacīdvāraṃ manodvāran ti tīni ~āni rakkha); III 35, 20´ (tīhi ~ehi duccaritaṃ na carati); IV 179, 20´ (kāyādīhi ~ehi upasanto sīlavā); Ap-a 110, 18 (mayā kāyena vācāya manasā cā ti tīhi ~ehi katan ti); As 84, 37* (~e caranti kammāni); 85, 10 (kāyadvārena kataṃ kammaṃ kāyakamman ti ~ena nāmaṃ labhati); 90, 25 (micchā carantassa kammaṃ kāyakammam eva hoti ~aṃ pi kāyadvāram eva); — ifc see kāya-, mano- ( sv mana[s] ), vacī-; — 4. entrance, opening (of the body) ; Vism 345, 30 foll. ([āhāro] ajjhohariyamāno c’ esa ekena ~ena pavisitvā nissandamāno … anekehi ~ehi nissandati); 346, 26 (imāni ~āni divase divase dhoviyamānāni pi n’ eva sucīni na manoramāni honti); Th-a II 135, 23 (tasmiṃ kaḷevare navahi ~ehi asuciṃ savati sandante); — °- koṭṭhaka , m. [dvāra + koṭṭhaka 1 ; BHS dvārakoṣṭhaka] a gatehouse; a room over the gate ; Abh 204; Ja I 348, 35 (~e sopānaṃ āruyha); II 218, 12 (nagaradvārasamīpaṃ gantvā ~aṃ disvā); Ap 43, 17 ; Mil 10, 31 ; Vism 388, 11 (Cūḷapanthako ~e ṭhatvā rodati); — ifc see bahi-; — °- kosa , m. , a door-frame; the area surrounding a door ; Vin IV 47, 23 (yāva ~ā; Sp 783, 18 : ~o nāma piṭṭhasaṅghāṭakassa samantā kavāṭavitthārappamāṇo okāso); — °- gāhe ca in Ee at Ap 125, 7 is wr for °-bāhāya ( Be, Ce so ), or °-bāhe ca ( Se so ); — °- jaggana , n. , attending to the door or gate ; Sp 282, 21 (nipajjanakāle pi ~aṃ nāma mahādvāre °-pālassa bhāro); — °- ṭṭha , m. , a doorkeeper; a gate-keeper ; Abh 341 (~o °-pālako); — °- (t)thakanaka , n. , closing of or with a gate ;? Sp 1220, 9 (apesī ti … kataṃ ~aṃ, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se katadvāratthakanakaṃ); — °- pānantarena in Ee at Ja VI 349, 20 is wr; Be, Se vātapānantarena; Ce °-vātapanantarena; — °- pāla , m. , a doorkeeper, a gatekeeper; a guard at the gate ; Ja I 352, 15 ; Ap 44, 8 (~o va saṃvaro); 393, 9 (nagare Bandhumatiyā ~o ahos’ ahaṃ); Mil 155, 22 ; Spk I 214, 3 (ekeko ekekaṃ °-bāhaṃ nissāya ~ā viya aṭṭhaṃsu); Dhp-a II 4, 21 (~aṃ pakkositvā dvāraṃ vivarā ti āha); — °- pālaka , m. , id. ; Abh 341 (°-ṭṭho ~o); Ap-a 481, 10 (rañño gehadvāre ~o āsiṃ); — °- bandha , m. , a door-frame; a doorway ;? Sp 571, 19 ; 783, 27 ; — sadvāra-bandha, mfn. , Sp 282, 28 ; 286, 12 ; — °- bandhana , n. , a terrace before a house ; Abh 218 (pamukhaṃ dvārabandhanaṃ); — °- bāhā , f. , a door-post ; Abh 219 (piṭṭhasaṅghāṭakadvārabāhā); D II 190, 5 (~aṃ ālambitvā aṭṭhāsi); Khp 7:1 (~āsu tiṭṭhanti); Dhp-a III 273, 14 (ekaṃ ~aṃ nissāya ekaṃ pādehi uppīḷetvā chamāya nisinnā suttaṃ kantati); — sadvārabāha, sadvārabāhaka, mfn. , together with the door-post(s) ; Ps II 116, 35 (sadvārabāhaṃ nagarakavāṭaṃ, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be -bāhakaṃ) = Mp III 265, 4 ( Ce, Ee so; Be, Se -bāhakaṃ) = Nidd-a I 86, 31 (-bāhakaṃ); — °- bhatta , n. , food placed before the door ; Sn 286 (Pj II 315, 11 foll. : brāhmaṇānaṃ dassāmā ti sajjetvā tehi tehi dāyakehi attano gharadvāre ṭhapitaṃ bhattaṃ); — °- rakkhaka , mf (-ikā) n. , (one) who guards the door or the means of access ; Dhp-a III 488, 19 (cha dvārāni pidahitvā °-rakkhikaṃ satiṃ avissajjetvā); Ap-a 286, 3 (°-pālo ~o ti attho); — °- rakkhanaka , mfn. , who guards the means of access ; Mp III 281, 10 (~en’ eva ñāṇena, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be °-rakkhaken’ eva); — °- rakkhi(n) , m. , a doorkeeper, a gatekeeper ; Sv 852, 7 (dovārikā ti ~ino); — °- vivaraka , m. , one who opens the gate ;? opening of or in the gate ;? Th-a II 151, 26 (gajanirodhato vā niggamanāya ~aṃ alabhamāno hatthī viya, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee °-vivaraṇaṃ); — °- sālā , f. a gatehouse; a room over the gate ; M I 382, 31 (majjhimāya ~āya āsanāni paññāpehī ti; Ps III 93, 18 foll. : yassa gharassa satta °-koṭṭhakā tassa sabba-abbhantarimato vā sabbabāhirato vā paṭṭhāya catutthadvārakoṭṭhako); II 61, 31 ; — advāra , n. , not a door ; Sp 748, 14 ; — sadvāra , mfn. , with a door ; M I 279, 12 (dve agārā ~ā); — see also advāraka, advārika, antaradvāre, kāyadvārika, cakkhudvārika, chadvārika ( sv cha 2 ), pañcadvārika, manodvārika ( sv mana[s] ), sotadvārika ( sv sota 1 ).
